vulnerabilities.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
vulnerabilities.description: Buffer overflow in the RPC parsing routine allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via crafted network packets.

vulnerabilities.title: Weak TLS 1.0/1.1 Protocol Negotiation Allowed
vulnerabilities.description: The remote server accepts legacy TLS 1.0 and 1.1 handshakes, enabling theoretical downgrade attacks and cipher block chaining weaknesses.

vulnerabilities.title: PostgreSQL Service Default Administrative Accounts
vulnerabilities.description: Database management daemon contains active default system credentials reachable over internal subnets without rate limiting.
